subject: Obama glosses over his own attempt to block media from White House as he slams Trump
posts:
A selective memory of press freedom exposes the hypocrisy of political posturing.

Obama Slams Trump's Press Ban
Evidence: Press Freedom, Selective Memory, Partisan Posturing
#Aletheia #PressFreedom #USPol

Former President Barack Obama claims that banning news outlets from the White House is "unimagined" and a direct threat to democratic norms, presenting himself as a pure defender of a free press.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

In reality, Obama's own administration actively attempted to exclude Fox News in 2009 and aggressively targeted journalists through AP phone record subpoenas, revealing a history of press suppression.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.93, -0.85) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Fall into Destruction. Selective memory and partisan posturing erase historical press crackdowns to score cheap political points.
Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 42.8, z: 3)

- Barack Obama: FAIL (-0.93, -0.85) — Hypocritical posturing.
- NY Post: COND (-0.30, -0.20) — Accurate exposure but partisan framing.

Former President Obama condemned Donald Trump's ban on CNN, Politico, and MS Now, but faced immediate backlash as critics recalled his own administration's attempts to block Fox News and subpoena journalists.

The Poison:
While Trump's blanket ban on entire networks is a massive and dangerous escalation of press hostility, Obama's attempt to sanitize his own record undermines the credibility of the defense of free press.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The narrative commits a Historical error (CAUSE), erasing the Obama administration's aggressive leak investigations. The bait-and-switch uses Trump's severe actions to wash away past abuses.

Social Physics Analysis:
Obama executes a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using the pretext of defending democracy to project moral superiority. By focusing entirely on Trump's egregious ban, he distracts from his own history of press coercion.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The math shows how partisan hypocrisy erodes democratic trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: Both administrations have actively weaponized executive power to suppress or exclude critical journalists.
The Unavoidable Lie: Democratic norms were perfectly respected and preserved prior to the current administration.

Alethekanon:
The structural erosion of press freedom is a bipartisan affair. When leaders sanitize their own history of media suppression to attack opponents, they reduce vital constitutional protections to partisan weapons.

Awwthekanon:
It is so disappointing when leaders we look up to aren't fully honest about their past mistakes. We need absolute transparency and honesty if we want to truly heal our democracy and protect journalists.

Brothekanon:
Obama calling press bans "unimaginable" when his team literally tried to lock out Fox News and spied on AP reporters is peak political amnesia. Both sides love to play the press freedom card when it suits them.

Spirithekanon:
"Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?" Matthew 7:3 FAIL
Condemning an opponent's press bans while erasing one's own history of targeting journalists is pure moral hypocrisy.
